name: docs-xx-hugo
description: sakaay 站点（Hugo + 自建主题 hugo-sakaay）

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-edu-kb.mjs && node scripts/seo-static.mjs && hugo server --port 1313 --disableFastRender --destination public-dev
scripts.build: node scripts/build-edu-kb.mjs && node scripts/seo-static.mjs && hugo --minify --cleanDestinationDir && node scripts/seo-fix-paged.mjs && node scripts/seo-gate.mjs
scripts.build:deploy: node scripts/build-edu-kb.mjs && node scripts/seo-static.mjs && hugo --minify --cleanDestinationDir && node scripts/seo-fix-paged.mjs && node scripts/seo-gate.mjs && node scripts/site-check.mjs public && node scripts/prepare-deploy.mjs
